newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW - Belo CEO sees TV revs slowdown.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Belo CEO sees TV revs slowdown.

text.p: A.H. Belo Corp has shown strong revenue growth in the first four months of the year but expects broadcast revenues to slow down in coming months, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Robert Decherd said.
Decherd said Belo's newspaper revenues were running stronger than expected and that television revenues remained firm in April and looked "promising" for May.
"The risk is how long these kind of revenue growth patterns can be sustained," he told Reuters in an interview following the company's annual meeting in Dallas.
